country.name: Germany
country.regulator: Free competitions (Gewinnspiele) must not require a stake. Paid lotteries need a German licence – licensed operators are on the GGL whitelist (Gemeinsame Glücksspielbehörde der Länder).
country.eligibility: Usually residents of Germany aged 18+ (some include Austria/Switzerland); check the Teilnahmebedingungen.
tips: A genuine Gewinnspiel names the organiser (Impressum) and has Teilnahmebedingungen.
You never pay a fee, call a premium-rate number (0137/0900) or give bank details to claim a prize. 'Gewinnbenachrichtigung' calls asking for money are scams.
Paid lotteries are only legal with a German licence – check the GGL whitelist.
country.paid_note: Paid lotteries in Germany need a licence (GGL whitelist)
